details.prediction: FINAL ANSWER: Among the three companies, Amazon (AMZN) plans to spend the most in capital expenditures (capex) in 2025. Based on guidance provided in late 2024 and early 2025 earnings reports, Amazon's capex is projected to exceed its 2024 spend of approximately $75 billion, driven primarily by investments in AWS and AI infrastructure. In comparison, Alphabet (GOOGL) has indicated 2025 capex in the range of $55-$60 billion, and Meta (META) has provided guidance in the range of $45-$50 billion.
